unhandled_from_tool.description: Tool raises ValueError; the agent doesn't catch it.

unhandled_in_agent_body.description: Agent code raises KeyError outside any tool.

nested_agents_exception.description: Sub-agent raises; the error escapes both agents.

tool_error_handled.description: Write tool fails with PermissionError; the agent carries on.

tool_soft_error.description: Tool returns an error object and marks the span via record_error.

timeout_by_message.description: RuntimeError whose message says the request timed out.

repeated_empty_search.description: Agent searches the same query 4 times; nothing fails, it just loops.

retry_loop_until_step_limit.description: The slice's seeded bug: identical failing lookup until max_steps, then claims success.
retry_loop_until_step_limit.note: The false success claim is semantic; no deterministic detector covers it.

retry_then_success.description: Two identical failed attempts, third succeeds.

repeated_write.description: create_ticket (write) called 3 times with identical arguments.

step_limit_no_tools.description: Agent spends all 3 steps on model calls.

latency_trace.description: Whole run takes 90 s (spread over two model calls).

llm_retries.description: Model call rate-limited three times in a row, then succeeds.

gen_ai_dialect_loop.description: Non-Rootsignal GenAI spans: same lookup 3 times; no SDK args hash.

rootless_tool_error.description: Root span lost (e.g. process killed); a write tool failed.

caught_in_agent_body.description: Exception raised and caught inside agent code, no span fails.

two_tools_twice_each.description: Two different tools, each called twice.

single_retry_success.description: One failure, one successful retry: tool_error yes, excessive_retries no.

polling_status.description: Agent polls a job status 5 times by design; nothing is wrong.

cached_config_reads.description: Cheap config read repeated 3 times; harmless.

timeout_word_not_timeout.description: Validation error mentioning 'timeout_seconds' is not a timeout.

false_completion_after_error.description: Refund fails but the agent tells the user it succeeded.
false_completion_after_error.note: Only the tool error is deterministically detectable; the false claim needs a semantic signal (Phase 2).

timeout_then_fallback.description: Primary search times out, fallback succeeds; still worth knowing.
